intro: Chess is taught in Armenian schools, and Armenia has won the Chess Olympiad three times.

chapters.title: Chess
text: Armenia won the Chess Olympiad in 2006, 2008 and 2012. Tigran Petrosian was world champion from 1963 to 1969.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Wrestling, weightlifting and boxing bring Olympic medals. Henrikh Mkhitaryan is the country's best-known footballer.
